Messages.Author: Ian Lee
Messages.Body:
If you contest a card with yourself, can you yield one copy and retain the
other copy without paying pool? (Realize that the second copy won't turn face
up till later; that's not an issue.)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. The cost to contest ("retain") is a pool. If you don't pay the
cost to contest the contested card, you yield.
